description: This file defines the LDAPSyncService class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for synchronizing LDAP users with the system, handling LDAP queries, user creation, updates, and deletion based on LDAP data.

classes.name: LDAPSyncService
classes.description: Service class responsible for synchronizing LDAP users with the local system, managing LDAP queries, user creation and updates, and handling LDAP configuration settings.

methods.name: getLDAPDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of LDAPDao used for LDAP data access operations.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAPService instance, binding with credentials if not already bound.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP configuration settings; throws exception if not configured.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Fetches employee numbers associated with multiple users from LDAP.

methods.name: fetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Fetches all LDAP users by querying LDAP server entries and mapping them to LDAPUser objects.

methods.name: getHashOfLDAPUser
methods.description: Generates a MD5 hash of LDAPUser object data for change detection.

methods.name: createSystemUsers
methods.description: Creates or updates system users based on LDAPUser data, handling cases for existing users, LDAP merges, and new user creation.

methods.name: trySaveEmployee
methods.description: Attempts to save employee data within a transaction, handles LDAP sync exceptions.

methods.name: warnMultiUserEmployee
methods.description: Logs a warning if an employee number is associated with multiple users.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists employee data ensuring unique work email and employee ID constraints.

methods.name: filterLDAPAuthProvider
methods.description: Filters and returns the LDAP authentication provider from a list of auth providers.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Performs LDAP synchronization: fetches LDAP users, creates/updates system users, and removes local users no longer present in LDAP.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Fetches LDAP directory entries based on configured lookup settings.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollection
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entries for a specific lookup setting, with caching.

methods.name: prepareLDAPUserFromEntry
methods.description: Maps an LDAP directory entry to an LDAPUser DTO, applying data mapping configurations.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specified attribute value from an LDAP entry.

methods.name: getSearchAttributes
methods.description: Determines LDAP attributes to be used for searching based on lookup settings and data mapping.

methods.name: deleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Deletes local system users whose LDAP entries are no longer available.
